title: Update manifest (the signed list of what an update contains)
description: `manifest.json` of an update bundle, signed as a whole by `manifest.sig` (an ECDSA P-256 / SHA-256 signature, base64 DER, over the exact bytes of this file; the public key is the one committed for the images, `linux/image/cosign.pub`). The host refuses an unsigned or wrongly signed manifest, a file whose hash or size differs, a file the manifest does not list, a path that is not a plain relative one, and a version that is not newer than the installed one. There is no unsigned channel: `stable` and `edge` are both signed. Provisional: written by the Rust host's updater (phase 2.5), no CI producer yet.

version.description: major.minor.patch, no pre-release and no build metadata.

entry.description: The program the slot is started from; it must be one of `files`.

path.description: Relative, forward slashes, plain names only: no `..`, no drive, no stream, no space.
